question: Please collect the information of the top 6 trade report with the highest closing prices. Refer to the document for all the information I want.
sql:
SELECT
  t.TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  t.MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
  END AS algorithm,
  t.Symbol AS symbol,
  t.LastPx AS openPrice,
  t.StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t,
UNNEST(t.Sides) AS s
ORDER BY t.StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6
